signs1: A silhouette in the crowd. You turn around — no one. {{name}} is in this sector.
Your ship was tampered with while you were away. Nothing stolen. Just proof he could.
A bartender warns you in a low voice. Someone was asking about you. The description matches {{name}}.
A bullet engraved on your pilot seat. No message. It doesn't need one.
signs2: He was at the previous station. He's following you. You won't shake him off like that.
Someone accessed your travel logs. Time and destination. {{name}} knows your route.
You hear his name twice within the same hour. Coincidence or message.
Your ship's door was forced open. The lock reset. He wanted you to know.
signs3: He's at this station. You know it. He knows you know it.
You caught a glimpse of him — a split second before he vanished. He's not hiding anymore.
Three people watched you leave this morning. One of them worked for him.
He sent you a message. Four words: "I'm waiting somewhere."

presence.t5: He's become a dark legend. Mercenaries travel with him now. He won't let you leave.
presence.t4Closing: He's recruited allies. They're converging on you.
presence.t4: People talk about him at the stations. He's offering a bounty for your location.
presence.t3Closing: He could show up at any moment. He knows it.
presence.t3: He's at this station. Watching you.
presence.t2Closing: He knows your route. He anticipates every move.
presence.t2: He's somewhere in this sector. Waiting for the right moment.
presence.t1Closing: He's getting closer. You've crossed paths once. He's looking for you.
presence.t1: A presence in the shadows. Someone's been following you for a while.

resolve.fleeSuccess: You bolt. -1 fuel. {{name}} waits for the next chance.
resolve.talkSuccess: Deal reached. {{name}} lifts the threat. +20 rep.
resolve.talkFail: He's not here to talk. Fight.
resolve.paySuccess: -{{amount}} cr. {{name}} takes it and disappears. For now.

enemy.allyDesc5: He brought reinforcements — two mercenaries cover his flanks.
enemy.allyDesc4: An accomplice is lying in wait. You're fighting on two fronts.
enemy.description: He was tracking you. He knows exactly how you fight. He won't stop.{{allyDesc}}
